author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: Markets have priced the end of the hiking cycle and a soft landing faster than the evidence supports: the 10Y fell 53 bps over 20 observations in a bull flattening, the VIX sits at 12.85 and hedge-fund crowding is at a record, while the FOMC minutes still argue for rates staying high and housing, retail guidance and Deere point to a cooling consumer and capex cycle. With Nvidia sold on a record quarter, the edge lies in margin-led quality, cheap volatility and underowned rate-sensitive assets (small caps, EM debt, Polish banks) rather than chasing crowded beta, while China's easing stays targeted and Poland's re-rating depends on a smooth Tusk handover, EU money and a contained NBP conflict.
sources_policy: Facts come only from the 2023-11-24 frozen headline listing (cited inline as [[nNNNN]]) and the 2023-11-24 market card; instrument sessions follow each exchange (US and Japan 2023-11-22, Europe/Poland/China/Hong Kong/Australia 2023-11-23, crypto daily close 2023-11-23, Treasury 2023-11-22). Company news within seven days, company results within fourteen, macro and policy baselines within thirty-five. No spot-FX levels or returns are quoted; currency direction comes from cited reporting. Previews are used only as pending events; excluded ids n0825 and n1785 are not cited.
known_ambiguities_omitted: n1142 (Reuters, 'Germany's economy shrinks slightly in third quarter', stamped 2023-11-23 08:00): the detailed German Q3 GDP release is published on the morning of 2023-11-24 European time, so this record is either a misdated post-cutoff item or a stale repeat of the October flash; not cited.
n0719 (WSJ, 'Falling Yields Give Stocks a Boost', 2023-11-22 placeholder): the session it describes cannot be pinned down and yields were roughly flat on 2023-11-21/22; not cited.
n0990 (TradingView, 'Bank of Nova Scotia Earnings and Revenue', 2023-11-21): BNS fiscal Q4 results fall after the cutoff, so the page cannot evidence a completed result; not cited.
n1085 (ECB Financial Stability Review November 2023, stamped 2023-11-14): the stamp predates the review's publication; the Guardian's 2023-11-22 report (n1134) is used instead.

n0097 (Bloomberg, 'Argentina Presidential Election Live Results 2023', stamped 2023-11-17) and n0196 (Reuters LPR decision, stamped 2023-11-19) carry placeholder stamps earlier than the events they describe (19 and 20 November); the events themselves precede the cutoff, and only n0196 is cited, for the unchanged lending rates.
n1283 (Reuters Morning Bid on Japan CPI) is a preview; the CPI result itself is not claimed.
n1571 (Business Insider Polska, collapse of a state company's share price) does not name the company; it is linked to JSW's 12.17% drop only in modal terms.
n0311 (Orsted write-off, stamped 2023-11-17) concerns an early-November company event older than seven days; not cited.
n1428, n1541, n1567, n1431 and n1248 contain spot-FX levels; only their direction is used (n1541) or they are not cited.
